question: Under what condition may a teacher grant the teaching that confers long life?
premises: The recipient must be thoroughly examined
This examination should always be done
Only then may the gift be given
inference: After careful examination, the teacher may give that which grants long life.
uncertainties: cirajīvitam may refer to the teaching or its fruit of long life.
plain_english: Having always examined him well, one may give to him that which brings long life.
